description: Read a paper ledger back: its open positions, cash and the last fills, newest first. Nothing is sent to an exchange. Three forms. With paper_id (the id a no-token paper fill on entry returned) and no token: that one guest ledger, returned as { paper_ledger: true, exchange, cash, positions: [{ symbol, qty, avg_price }], fills: [{ symbol, side, qty, price, notional, bid, ask, quote_at, at }], more_fills, note }. With your user's Autoview account token and no paper_id: the account's own paper ledgers, one per exchange, as { paper_ledger: true, ledgers: [{ exchange, cash, positions, fills, more_fills }], note }; ledgers is empty when the account has none yet. With the token and a paper_id: that guest ledger moves onto the account (first claim wins; the reply carries claimed:true on the call that moved it) and is returned in the account form, ledgers holding just that one; this is the only form that writes, and once moved the paper_id no longer works without the token. qty is signed (negative is short); positions that are flat are left out; cash is null until a starting balance is set; amounts are in the symbol's quote currency. more_fills is true when older fills exist beyond limit. A refusal returns { error, code }: paper_id_unknown (no guest ledger has that paper_id), paper_id_other_exchange (exchange names another venue than the ledger's), paper_ledger_needs_id (neither paper_id nor a token), invalid_token, paper_exchange_out_of_scope (the token is not scoped for that exchange), paper_ledger_unavailable (try again shortly), paper_rate_limited (the paper_id form with no token is limited to 60 per hour from each connection, counted together with paper_reset; wait until retry_at), paper_id_claimed (with a token: another account already took that paper_id's ledger), paper_id_not_merged (with a token: the account already has its own paper ledger on that exchange, so it is kept, the guest ledger is not merged, and nothing changed).

exchange.description: optional: with a token, read only the ledger on this exchange (e.g. GEMINI); with paper_id, it must match the ledger's exchange

limit.description: how many of the newest fills to return, 1 to 100; defaults to 20

paper_id.description: the paper_id a no-token paper fill on entry returned, 32 hex characters; with no token reads that guest ledger, with a token moves it onto the account and reads it

token.description: your Autoview account token — an av_mcp_ personal access token, generate one at /account/tokens/ on the Autoview site. Omit this if your MCP client already sends it as an `Authorization: Bearer` header (Claude Code, Cursor, and most non-browser clients do this automatically once configured). With paper_id as well, it moves that guest ledger onto the account.

name: paper_ledger
